title: Etale Godement model exact on supported coefficient terms
statement:
Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion of Noetherian schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion], and let $j:U=X\setminus Z\hookrightarrow X$ be its open complement. Fix a small conservative family $P$ of geometric points of $X_{\mathrm{et}}$, in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], with stalks [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. For a finite commutative ring $R$ and an ordinary etale $R$-module sheaf $F$, use [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and set
$$T(F)=\prod_{p\in P}p_*F_p,\qquad G^q(F)=T^{q+1}(F)\ (q\geq0),$$
with differential the alternating sum of the germ-unit insertions and zero terms in negative degrees. Here $p_*M(V)=\prod_{v:\,p\to V}M$ for an etale $V\to X$, and $T$ acts on maps coordinatewise. Set
$$S_i(F)=i^{-1}\ker(G^\bullet(F)\longrightarrow j_*j^{-1}G^\bullet(F)),\qquad E_i(F)=\Gamma(Z,S_i(F)),$$
using the supported kernel of [def-pur-etale-supported-kernel]. Then the augmentation $F[0]\to G^\bullet(F)$ is a quasi-isomorphism. There are natural identifications
$$Q S_i(F)\simeq i^!F,\qquad H^m(E_i(F))\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_{D(Z_{\mathrm{et}},R)}(R_Z,i^!F[m])$$
for every integer $m$, where $i^!$ is the bounded-below right adjoint of exact closed direct image $i_*$ [def-per-closed-support-plus-adjunction], and $Q$ denotes localization of complexes. In particular a cocycle in $E_i(F)^m$ represents its indicated derived morphism by sending $1$ to that cocycle in the complex $S_i(F)[m]$.
For every short exact sequence $0\to F_1\to F_2\to F_3\to0$ of $R$-module sheaves, both $0\to S_i(F_1)\to S_i(F_2)\to S_i(F_3)\to0$ and $0\to E_i(F_1)\to E_i(F_2)\to E_i(F_3)\to0$ are short exact in every degree. The same formulas, maps and derived identifications commute with restriction of scalars along every homomorphism of finite commutative rings; the resulting $i^!$ comparison respects the closed adjunction counit. For a locally constant locally free rank-one $R_X$-module sheaf $L$ (etale locally isomorphic to $R_X$), the natural tensor map
$$S_i(F)\otimes_R i^{-1}L\longrightarrow S_i(F\otimes_R L)$$
is an isomorphism of complexes, inducing the canonical comparison $i^!F\otimes_R i^{-1}L\simeq i^!(F\otimes_R L)$ in the derived category.

source.place: Expose XVI, Proposition 3.3.2, printed p.245, the elementary Godement-resolution properties used before choosing compatible fundamental-class cocycles; supported-kernel interpretation: literature/stacks-project/etale-cohomology.tex, Tag 09XQ (lemma-sections-with-support-acyclic) and the preceding definition of the sheaf of sections with support. The coefficient-exact and geometric-point Godement formulation is the explicit technical input to that construction.

from.place: Proof Step 3: dimension-normalized Verdier duality, regular finite-torsion local model; pointwise purity and composition used to compare the normalized curve with the ambient regular scheme. Input: Gabber purity for a regular Noetherian closed pair. More precisely: Expose XVI, Proposition 3.3.2, printed p.245: compatible Godement cocycles for the fundamental classes and triangles C(mu) -> C(mu+nu) -> C(nu); coefficient compatibility of Proposition 3.3.1. Technical input for the Godement construction: supported exact resolution of arbitrary finite-coefficient sheaves, before any fundamental class is chosen.
